program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to prediction to reasoning chain
question: Can representations learned directly from independently sourced external raw bytes feed the already-qualified Wingless factorized compositional-reasoning mechanism and generalize to exact operand pairs never observed during reasoning training?
hypothesis: Learn the unchanged 512-entry raw-byte representation from the first 60% of each verified external source exactly as in WLM-LM-EXTERNAL-RAW-REP-PRED-R1. Deterministically take the top eight learned four-byte motifs under the same R2 ranking as a raw value alphabet. Using the unchanged factorized three-bit reasoning learner and the frozen heldout-pair rule, factorized heldout accuracy and raw-output exact accuracy will each be at least 0.95 on sixteen unseen operand pairs, while an exact represented-pair lookup control will remain at or below 0.25.

portfolio_context.frontier: external raw-input -> learned representation -> qualified prediction -> compositional reasoning

scope_statement: This is an interface-integration reasoning gate. External bytes determine the learned raw representation alphabet, while the compositional target relation remains a frozen controlled benchmark. Passing does not establish open-domain semantic reasoning; it establishes that externally learned raw representations can feed the qualified compositional inference stage without tokenization or model calls.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

representation_stage.sources: same three exact SHA-256-verified external sources as the supported prediction gate
representation_stage.input: first floor(0.60*N) raw bytes from each source only, with source boundaries resetting byte windows
representation_stage.reasoning_value_selection: rank the learned 512 motifs by the same best-successor-count, consistency, lexicographic order and take the first eight; then assign value IDs 0..7 by lexicographic order of those eight raw motifs

reasoning_benchmark.record_encoding: three fixed-width four-byte slots: operand A motif, operand B motif, observed target motif; heldout queries contain only the two operand slots
reasoning_benchmark.target_law: target_id = operand_a_id XOR operand_b_id; used only by benchmark construction/scoring, never prediction
reasoning_benchmark.slot_decoding: map each exact four-byte slot to the lexicographic ID of the learned external motif; no parser, tokenizer, semantic labels, or target law is available to prediction

reasoning_learner.factorized_state: three 2x2x2 integer count tensors over operand-bit pair and target bit, 24 counters total
reasoning_learner.prediction: independently argmax target bit for each bit position and reassemble one value ID
reasoning_learner.lookup_control: 8x8x8 exact-pair target counts, 512 counters, lowest-ID tie break

validity_criteria: Exact sealed external-prediction parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration commit and the frozen external manifest.
All external source hashes and byte lengths match before representation learning; only first-60% prefixes enter representation learning.
The external representation learner is scientifically identical to the qualified 512-motif R2 learner.
The eight reasoning values are selected deterministically before reasoning benchmark generation using the frozen representation ranking and are distinct.
The factorized learner sees only decoded learned representation IDs and observed training target IDs; prediction cannot call XOR or evaluator target code.
Every exact heldout operand pair is absent from reasoning training, while every per-bit input combination needed by the factorized learner occurs in training.
The exact-pair lookup control receives the same represented training examples.
Raw-output scoring maps the predicted value ID back to the learned external four-byte motif and requires exact byte equality.
Full Go regression passes before the probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, semantic parser, external model, persistent corpus, capacity growth, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and factorized heldout accuracy exceeds lookup accuracy, but one or more representation-interface, 0.95 reasoning, or raw-output thresholds fail.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but factorized heldout accuracy does not exceed lookup accuracy or the external learned representation cannot support the bounded compositional inference.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, representation-equivalence, leakage, target-law isolation, deterministic-state, capacity, or host-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter external sources, 60% representation prefixes, 512/8 capacities, ranking, value-ID assignment, reasoning law, split, repetitions, factorization, lookup control, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority requirements after any primary output.
